name: The State Tretyakov Gallery
known: Directors: Zelfira Tregulova from 2015 to February 2023.

Board of trustees, undated: chaired by Andrei Belousov, "Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation"; the other 15 include the heads of Gazprombank, Renova Group, VTB, Transneft, PSB and Severstal (partners.tretyakov.ru).
Director Zelfira Tregulova removed 9 Feb 2023 after a Ministry-forwarded complaint of 'destructive ideology'.

name: VDNKh (Exhibition of Achievements of National Economy)
Victory Museum (Central Museum of the Great Patriotic War)
Winzavod Centre for Contemporary Art
known: Founded by the businessman Roman Trotsenko (Wikipedia) and opened in 2007.

Founders' money: in 2006 The Art Newspaper reported Roman Trotsenko and his wife Sophia backing a $4 million project, which he called a "non-profit art development project"; each of five Moscow galleries was to rent about 300 square metres at a discount for five years (John Varoli, 31 March 2006).
Wikipedia names Roman Trotsenko as founder.

name: Arsenal, Volga-Vyatka branch of the Pushkin Museum
known: Anna Gor headed the branch in 2021 (Kommersant interview, 30 June 2021) and is now listed as adviser to the head of the branch.
Alexander Komarov is head of the branch, with deputies Elena Belova and Andrei Bogolepov (Arsenal website).
Support page: the Council of Patrons was founded by Sergey Ivanushkin, Yuri Gaysinsky and Irina Sedykh and their families.
Founder-director Anna Gor became a Pushkin deputy director;

name: Tikhaya Studio
known: Founded in spring 2015 by the artist Artem Filatov, who is its director (RBC Style, 1 May 2025; obdn.ru, 8 September 2022).
Filatov calls it a "studio-commune" (The Blueprint), which names Filatov, chief curator Alisa Savitskaya and development director Natasha Korenchenko as key figures.
Rustam is the husband of development director Natalya Korenchenko.

name: PERMM Museum of Contemporary Art
known: FSB searched the museum and director Nailya Allakhverdieva's home on 21 Nov 2024 in a 'terrorism justification' case against founder Gelman.

name: Perm State Art Gallery
known: Its founder is the Ministry of Culture of Perm Krai, and it is a state regional budgetary cultural institution (the gallery's information page).
Director Yulia Tavrizyan; sponsor list not published on the site.

name: DK Rozy (Rosa's House of Culture)
known: Garage names Roman Abramovich and Dasha Zhukova as co-founders and calls itself a non-profit project of The IRIS Foundation (Garage website).

name: State Museum of the History of Religion
The State Hermitage Museum
known: On 2 October 2022 Dmitry Ozerkov, head of contemporary art, announced his resignation, saying "I don't intend to have anything in common with today's Russia" (USA Art News, 3 October 2022).

Gazprom was general sponsor of the permanent exhibition "Peter the Great Gallery", which opened in the Winter Palace on 14 January 2022; the chairman of Gazprom's management board, Alexey Miller, attended the opening, and Gazprom helped restore the ivory chandelier (Komsomolskaya Pravda, 17 January
Director Mikhail Piotrovsky explicitly weaponized museum diplomacy as 'cultural operations' in support of state military aggression.

name: Victoria Gallery
known: The first director was Lyudmila Patrati (VK long read, Vse v Samare).
Mikhelson is chairman of the management board of Novatek (UK Sanctions List), described as Russia's second-largest gas company (The Art Newspaper, 2022).
Its About page names founder Leonid Mikhelson and three managers.

name: Manege Central Exhibition Hall
known: Pavel Prigara is listed as director in a Sobaka.ru profile of 7 February 2017.
Anna Yalova, previously deputy director for development, was acting director from September 2022 and became director in February 2023.
Board of trustees: Semyon Mikhailovsky, rector of the Repin St Petersburg Academy of Arts, as chair;
Olga Galaktionova, director of the Tretyakov Gallery since January 2026;
Mikhail Piotrovsky, director of the Hermitage; and Valery Fokin, president of the Alexandrinsky Theatre (Manege website).

name: New Holland Island
known: Millhouse LLC, founded by Roman Abramovich, won the 2010 tender to restore the buildings and reorganise the island (Fontanka, 8 June 2022).
